summary: Iteration 34: Tested new Research adherence report + Google Sheets live CSV feeds (backend + frontend). All 17 pytest backend tests pass covering /api/research/adherence (admin only; coach/athlete 403; math verified; team filter; period filter), adherence_weekly dataset (datasets=12, preview, xlsx, csv exports), and /api/research/feeds (admin create/list/revoke, 403 for coach/athlete, 400 for unknown dataset, public CSV fetch without auth, anonymize column handling, access_count increment, 404 after revoke). Frontend UI verified: 3 tabs render on /staff/research-data, datasets export buttons live inside filter card, Adherence tab shows 16 athletes with 34% overall for 2026-07-01..2026-07-31 and tooltips/metric select (5 options) work, Sheets live tab creates a feed with correct =IMPORTDATA("<REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL>/api/research/feed/<token>.csv") formula and revokes successfully. Mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow on Adherence tab. All test-created feeds revoked.

issues: Recharts console warnings on page load: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' (chart container renders with zero size until layout). Non-blocking but noisy; add minWidth/minHeight or render chart after mount.

action_items: (Optional) Fix Recharts container size warnings on Research Data page by giving the chart wrapper an explicit minHeight or deferring render until container has size.
critical_code_review_comments: research_export_routes.py grew to 568 lines and now mixes exports, adherence, feeds and period-stats; consider splitting feeds + adherence into separate modules.

public_feed does not rate-limit or guard against very large datasets (e.g. ostrc_responses with no team filter) — a public URL that triggers heavy aggregation could be abused. Consider a hard row cap or 429 throttle per token.
Public feed CSV does not include a 'generated_at'/row-count comment line; researchers using IMPORTDATA won't easily know freshness.
_adherence double-queries daily_readiness / training_sessions / recovery_* (once here, once elsewhere in build()); fine for now but duplicates I/O when exporting adherence alongside other datasets.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Created 2 feeds during backend tests and 1 feed during frontend UI test — all revoked. Verified GET /api/research/feeds returns [] at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoints live under /api/research: GET /adherence (admin), dataset adherence_weekly, POST/GET /feeds, DELETE /feeds/{id}, public GET /feed/{token}.csv. Research page now has 3 tabs. App 'today' ~2026-10-14, so period_days=30 feeds for morning_checkin legitimately return no_data (demo data is Jun-Jul 2026). Use start=2026-07-01&end=2026-07-31 for non-zero adherence.
